# prefer-small-explicit-contracts

Severity: should

Scope: src/** — this Rule reaches a Change whose declared scope.paths share a root with these, and your host also treats them as file globs.

Prefer small, testable modules with explicit contracts over broad shared helpers. Judgement guidance only; XForge does not claim to enforce it.

Enforcement: gates=none; policies=none; approvals=none.
